name: cw-autoresolve
description: Answers Claude Code's Bash safety dialogs (Yes for allow-listed commands, No otherwise) at the permission check via claude-watch's autoresolve rules. On by default.

enabled.title: Enable cw-autoresolve
enabled.description: On by default. When false the mod registers nothing and writes nothing.

claudeWatchBin.title: claude-watch binary
claudeWatchBin.description: Command used to reach the decider and heartbeat (argv[0]; looked up on PATH).

heartbeatSecs.title: Heartbeat interval (seconds)
heartbeatSecs.description: How often the liveness heartbeat is written. Keep well under claude-watch autoresolve.mod_heartbeat_max_age_secs (default 60).

deciderTimeoutSecs.title: Decider timeout (seconds)
deciderTimeoutSecs.description: How long to wait for claude-watch to decide before letting the engine's own dialog open.
